name: Academic Research Paper
description: Standard peer-reviewed academic paper template with rigorous section decomposition and citation requirements.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.description: High-level summary of research problem, methodology, key findings, and contributions.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.description: Background context, motivation, research questions, and scope.

sections.title: 2. Literature Review
sections.description: Synthesis of existing academic literature, identifying gaps and foundational work.

sections.title: 3. Research Methodology
sections.description: Analytical framework, data collection methods, and experimental design.

sections.title: 4. Results & Findings
sections.description: Empirical results, structured evidence analysis, and quantitative/qualitative data.

sections.title: 5. Discussion & Limitations
sections.description: Interpretation of results, implications, and explicit research limitations.

sections.title: 6. Conclusion & Future Work
sections.description: Summary of core contributions and directions for future research.

sections.title: References
sections.description: Full bibliographic list of verified sources.
